card.name: Inside capitalized EMBRYO-FETAL in warnings
card.fires_on: The final letters of the all-caps word EMBRYO (the O in EMBRY-O) in boxed warning headings such as EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY. It also fires weakly partway through other all-caps words like WATERSHEDS and AGGRAVATE.

modes.label: EMBRYO-FETAL heading
modes.description: The O ending EMBRY in the all-caps boxed warning title EMBRYO-FETAL TOXICITY.

modes.label: Other all-caps words
modes.description: Partway through other long capitalized words, in headings or uppercase text.
